passes.input: the DAT2 HD base as staged by dat2_upscale.py, before cast_shadows.py's strip (bd54399f8d commits it after the strip)
passes.mask: alpha >= 220, max RGB < 75, chroma < 40, opened twice, regions > 1500 HD px, dilated 6, inside alpha > 0

passes.prompt: hand-painted top-down strategy game sprite, sunlit pale sand arena floor with fine cracks and grooves, same painterly style and lighting as the rest of the image, plain bare sand only, no shadow, no dark areas, no plants, no objects
